message: Legacy AI provider environment variables are imported once and then ignored
bullet_points: Rotate credentials in Admin → AI providers; the `BASEROW_*` variables no longer take effect.
Imported credentials are stored in the database, so they appear in database dumps.
A workspace with a credential but no models now has no models available.
A workspace with models but no credential now uses the instance model list.
A workspace with a credential but no endpoint uses the provider's default endpoint.
Kuma stays on its environment model until you mark one available and select it.
